reports.symptomSummary: Cluster of fever, joint pain and skin rash in three neighbourhoods; dengue suspected.
Mild seasonal influenza cases in two primary schools; students sent home for five days.
Increase in acute diarrhoea after a water supply interruption; chlorine levels being checked.
Heat-related illness among outdoor workers: dizziness, dehydration and muscle cramps.
Isolated cases of conjunctivitis in a boarding school; no complications reported.
Respiratory infections with persistent cough reported in a shelter; samples sent to the lab.
Food poisoning after a community event; 14 people treated, all recovering well.
Allergic reactions linked to high pollen concentration; antihistamine demand increased.
Rising number of mosquito-borne fever cases after heavy rains; fumigation scheduled.
Whooping cough suspected in two unvaccinated infants; contact tracing in progress.
Carbon monoxide exposure in two households during a cold spell; both families recovered.
Routine surveillance: no unusual symptoms detected this week.
